newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Salman al-Khalifa has emphasised the need to promote and preserve unity among the peoples of Gulf Cooperation Council member states.
-Qatar said that a proposed increase in the capital of Gulf Air will not end its cash crisis.
- Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary General Jameel al-Hujilan on Tuesday welcomed Qatar's decision to freeze the process of normalising relations with Israel.
- Bahrain insists on boycotting the GCC summit in Doha.
- The UAE offset programme said it will announce two new projects in the services sector.
-Kuwait will make last payment of its foreign debt in December.
